scope: Primary-source audit of all 31 standalone families. No public result matches the measured GB300 B=100 kernel, dimensions, layout, precision, software path, and timing protocol simultaneously; nearby results are context, not expected-latency baselines.
methodology: Only first-party project repositories, official benchmark datasets and reports, vendor documentation, and original papers qualify as sources.
An exact curve requires the same callable or kernel lineage, dimensions and layout, precision, hardware class, and timing scope. A mismatch in any of these fields is shown explicitly.
Benchmark source code without committed measurements is labeled harness-only; a definition with zero traces is not called a curve.
Numeric points are copied from the linked primary source without interpolation. The local GB300 sweep remains the only exact curve for this deployment contract.

evidence_classes.label: Exact published curve
evidence_classes.definition: Published measurements match the local kernel lineage, dimensions, layout, precision, hardware, and timing scope.

evidence_classes.label: Published neighboring curve
evidence_classes.definition: A first-party curve exists for the same kernel family or operation, but at least one material contract field differs.

evidence_classes.label: Published neighboring result
evidence_classes.definition: A first-party table, heatmap, speedup summary, or system result is relevant, but it is not an exact per-kernel curve for this row.

evidence_classes.label: Official harness · no measurements
evidence_classes.definition: First-party benchmark code or a formal definition exists, but no committed result curve was located.

evidence_classes.label: Official implementation · no measurements
evidence_classes.definition: The official API or source establishes semantics, but no relevant public benchmark output was located.
